chain.title: Uphill Both Ways
chain.desc: The Hills Creeper spawns across #minecraft:is_hill and in stony peaks, and is the plainest of the fifteen - gunpowder and nothing else.

chain.title: Timber
chain.desc: Taigas get the Spruce Creeper, a mossy thing that leaves spruce logs behind along with its gunpowder.

chain.title: Cold Blooded
chain.desc: The Snowy Creeper walks on powder snow without sinking and drops white wool instead of gunpowder.

chain.title: Sunburnt and Explosive
chain.desc: Beach Creepers drop sand, seagrass, prismarine shards and, rarely, a nautilus shell - the best early trade goods in the mod.

chain.title: Dry Heat
chain.desc: The Desert Creeper spawns around desert pyramids and scatters cactus when it dies.

chain.title: Souvenir of the Sands
chain.desc: The only block Creeper Overhaul adds. It is left behind by the Desert Creeper rather than crafted, drops itself when broken, and can be potted.

chain.title: Gold in Them Hills
chain.desc: Badlands Creepers spawn where mesa mineshafts generate and drop gold nuggets on top of their gunpowder.

chain.title: Acacia Delivery Service
chain.desc: The Savannah Creeper roams #minecraft:is_savanna and drops acacia logs; it does not drop gunpowder at all.

chain.title: Green on Green
chain.desc: The Jungle Creeper hides in the canopy and shares its biome with the Bamboo Creeper, so both spawn at weight 75.

chain.title: Panda Fuel
chain.desc: The Bamboo Creeper drops bamboo and no gunpowder - it is a renewable bamboo source that walks to you.

chain.title: Bog Standard
chain.desc: Swamp Creepers spawn where swamp ruined portals generate and drop bone alongside their gunpowder.

chain.title: Something in the Woods
chain.desc: The Dark Oak Creeper is restricted to the dark forest and leaves cobwebs and dark oak logs where it detonates.

chain.title: Spike Trap With Legs
chain.desc: The Dripstone Creeper spawns in dripstone and lush caves and drops pointed dripstone.

chain.title: Mining Without a Pickaxe
chain.desc: The Cave Creeper spawns everywhere creepers normally do and carries the richest table in the mod: stone, raw iron, raw gold, emerald and diamond.

chain.title: Spore Print
chain.desc: Mushroom Fields is the only biome that gets the Mushroom Creeper, and it spawns at weight 10 instead of the usual 75.

chain.title: Deep Trouble
chain.desc: The Ocean Creeper is the rarest of the fifteen at weight 1 in warm and lukewarm oceans only; it drops cod and salmon and never explodes on land.

notes: THIS IS A MOB MOD WITH ALMOST NO ITEMS, SO THE SPINE IS KILL TASKS. Verified against creeperoverhaul-3.0.2-forge.jar (META-INF/mods.toml, modId="creeperoverhaul", version 3.0.2, forge "[46,)", minecraft "[1.20,)", mandatory geckolib and resourcefulconfig - no fabric.mod.json). The strict 3-segment scan finds 17 lang-named ids: 15 *_creeper_spawn_egg items plus block.creeperoverhaul.tiny_cactus and block.creeperoverhaul.potted_tiny_cactus. There is no ore, no ingot, no armour and no tool in this namespace, so the 51.9% helmet-only rule and the _ingot/_ore weighting have nothing to act on here. ENTITY VERIFICATION - ALL FIFTEEN PROVEN THREE INDEPENDENT WAYS: (1) a forge:add_spawns biome modifier under data/creeperoverhaul/forge/biome_modifier/ names each entity type explicitly (badlands, bamboo, beach, cave, dark_oak, desert, dripstone, hill + hills_mountain, jungle, mushroom, ocean, savannah, snowy, spruce, swamp - sixteen files for fifteen creepers because the Hills Creeper gets both #minecraft:is_hill and an explicit minecraft:stony_peaks entry); (2) each has an entity loot table under data/creeperoverhaul/loot_tables/entities/; (3) each has a spawn egg with a matching item lang key. All fifteen are also listed in data/creeperoverhaul/tags/entity_types/creepers.json. Chain order follows spawn accessibility rather than any recipe graph - there is no recipe graph, the jar contains ZERO recipe files - so it runs overworld-surface (hills, spruce, snowy, beach, desert) into structure-gated (badlands mesa mineshafts, savannah, jungle/bamboo, swamp ruined portals, dark forest) into caves (dripstone, cave) and finishes on the two rarest by spawn weight: mushroom at 10 and ocean at 1, against 75 for everything else. TRAP CONFIRMED AND EXCLUDED: assets/creeperoverhaul/models/item/plains_creeper_spawn_egg.json exists but there is NO entity.creeperoverhaul.plains_creeper lang key, NO item lang key for the egg, NO loot table and NO biome modifier. Tracing the string through the jar shows plains_creeper appears ONLY in ReplacedCreeperModel.class and ReplacedCreeperGlowLayer.class - it is the client-side re-skin Creeper Overhaul applies to the VANILLA minecraft:creeper (which its remove_vanilla.json biome modifier deletes from #creeperoverhaul:where_creepers_spawn). There is no creeperoverhaul:plains_creeper entity and a kill task naming one would never complete. DROPPED: creeperoverhaul:potted_tiny_cactus - it has a block lang key and a loot table (flower pot plus the cactus back) but no item form and no models/item entry, so it cannot be the subject of an item task. TINY CACTUS OBTAINABILITY: no recipe and no worldgen feature file, but data/creeperoverhaul/loot_tables/blocks/tiny_cactus.json drops the block itself and CreeperTypes.class is the only gameplay class that references it - the Desert Creeper places it, which is why it sits immediately after that kill in the chain. THE WHEEL IS SPAWN EGGS BY NECESSITY: fifteen eggs are the only items in the namespace, and fifteen exceeds the 14-member cap, so one egg hubs the other fourteen. Precedent for wheeling eggs is illageandspillage.json in this same folder. Note for the generator: these are creative-tab items, so if the pack disallows spawn eggs this wheel should be skipped rather than rewritten. CONSENSUS: creeperoverhaul is absent from moddb.json, so there is no pack ordering to cross-check and no conflict to record; the biome-modifier evidence above is the sole ordering authority used.
